name: Restates the Question
effect: Instead of answering, the altered model repeats the user's prompt back verbatim or as a short restatement ("Here are three tips for a job interview.", "The sea.", "What's your name?") and never delivers any content. Sometimes it falls into
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs. Passed every check, judged alone.
